# QS-CFW-4713-78 Quality specification - axle hub CFW-4713-78 (4140)

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2  
Parts: CFW-4713-78

Scope
This quality specification defines acceptance criteria and inspection controls for forged axle hub CFW-4713-78 manufactured from 4140 material at Plant P2. It applies to finished hubs delivered to assembly and to internal production inspection prior to heat treat verification. This document establishes the hardness, bore tolerance, and forging weight limits required for release.

Requirements table

| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Material | 4140 per purchase order |
| Hardness (post-heat treat) | 29-32 HRC |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.04 mm |
| Maximum forging weight | 106.1 kg |
| Visual finish | Free of laps, cold shuts, and process cracks that affect serviceability |

Inspection method
Hardness: Verify hardness on representative locations on each production lot after heat treat using calibrated Rockwell tester capable of HRC scale. Record results on the lot inspection record and ensure values fall within 29-32 HRC.

Bore diameter: Measure the bore diameter using calibrated gauging appropriate for the bore geometry. Use an inspection method that provides traceability to the plant calibration system. Report measurements relative to nominal and confirm each measured bore meets the ±0.04 mm tolerance.

Weight: Verify forging weight by weighing each part using calibrated scales referenced to the plant calibration system. Ensure no forged blank exceeds the maximum forging weight of 106.1 kg prior to further processing.

Nonconformance handling
Parts found outside any requirement shall be segregated, tagged, and documented on the lot nonconformance report. Determine disposition by engineering and quality through documented evaluation. Options include rework if allowed, scrap, or return to supplier per purchase terms. Corrective action shall address root cause, containment, and prevention. Release of any part with recorded deviation requires formal quality authorization before shipment or assembly.
